For Petitioners : Ms.S.Shanmitha

For Respondents : Mr.K.M.D.Muhilan,
 Additional Public Pr  ORDER

This writ petition has been filed seeking to forbear the respondents from interfering in the running of the Restaurant Cum Bar premise namely CHAPTR along with Herbal Hookah services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine) at No.29 Thirumalai Pillai Road, T.Nagar Town Mambalam Taluk, Chennai 600 017.
2.

The learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is ready to give an undertaking that he will allot a separate smoking area for serving of Herbal Hookah Services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine) in his business premises.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/05/2025 04:15:55 pm )

3. Per contra, the learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents submitted that even if they provide separate smoking space, the permission under the Department of Food Safety is mandated.

4. In view of the said submission made by either parties, there shall be a direction to the petitioner forthwith to make an application before the Department of Food Safety and obtain an appropriate permission for providing Herbal Hookah Services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine).

The petitioner shall also give an undertaking letter before the respondent police to have separate smoking area for serving Herbal Hookah Services (without any content or trace of Tobacco and Nicotine).
On receipt of the said undertaking, the respondent police are directed not to interfere with the business premises of the petitioner after getting permission by the Department of Food Safety.
5. It is made clear that the petitioner will strictly adhere the undertaking and will not violate it by taking advantage of the order passed by this Court.

I also further make it clear that it will not prevent https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/05/2025 04:15:55 pm ) the respondent police for making the periodical inspection as to whether the undertaking is followed by the petitioner.
